policy.transition_rule: send once when an exact-pair candidate ENTERS actionable REAL_ALERT; re-arm after it leaves actionable state
requires: matching real-alerts.json row with status=REAL_ALERT and actionable_research_alert=true
policy.manual_execution: Telegram is a review alert only; no automatic trade is executed
policy.dedupe: one alert per transition into actionable state for chain+token+exact_pair
policy.telegram_timestamp: every delivered message includes explicit Asia/Jerusalem send date/time plus original signal T0
policy.delivery_retries: up to 3 attempts on transient Telegram/network failures
policy.audit_id: each delivery has a stable alert_event_id derived from exact-pair key plus send timestamp
policy.state_writer: only configured production lanes may write Telegram state/report; unconfigured scan lanes are read-only no-ops
